# Level 4 — Senior Backend Engineer — Grade C (System ownership)

**Audience:** Mid-level engineers with production experience.

**Graduation outcome:** Independently leads the design and delivery of a significant subsystem, makes reliable architecture decisions, manages technical risks, and guides less-experienced engineers.

| Structured study | Recorded video | Lessons |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 150–220 plus substantial real-world practice h | 25–35 h | 65–90 |

## Capstone — Reliability and Performance Redesign (`SRC-CAP`)

Own the order-processing subsystem and redesign it to meet explicit availability, latency, and recovery targets, with architecture docs, performance evidence, failure-injection tests, and an operational handover.

**Graduation gate:** Scenario-based design review and production-incident simulation.

See [`projects/ladder.md`](../../projects/ladder.md) for the full brief and [`assessment/framework.md`](../../assessment/framework.md) for grading.
